title: unona selanica
intro: Unona selanica, commonly known as a species of plant in the family Annonaceae, is a flowering plant native to Madagascar. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Unona selanica include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which may contribute to its use in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Unona selanica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
